title: flaremc ranks retextured
description: This texture pack changes the texture of ranks on the server flaremc
body:
![## Flare Ranks Retextured](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c49a8845bfc84810f49a3d22513b9cb64a8d641.png)

**make sure to check the how to use section**

A simple resource pack that retextures all of the rank textures on FlareMC to make them cleaner, easier to read, and a bit nicer overall while still fitting the original style.

server ip: play.flaremc.org

![tablist example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b2d16e6939ce141462f5bdb9faaeb180fc77d22.png)
This pack changes the rank textures everywhere they appear, including:

- Chat
- Tab list
- Above player names
- Other server UI elements

The goal of this pack was to make the ranks more readable and overall improve the look of the ranks ingame.

## Features ✨

- Cleaner rank textures
- Improved readability
- Vanilla-esc look
- Lightweight 16x pack
- changes the rank textures everywhere they appear

## How to use 📦

Minecraft versions: 1.21.8–1.26.1 (will show an error on older or newer versions but will probably still work)

Resolution: 16x

**Requires a resource pack priority mod to allow you to give priority to this pack over the default FlareMC server resource pack**

This pack was mainly tested using
My Resource Pack, My Choice:
https://modrinth.com/mod/my-resource-pack

these mods also work:
https://modrinth.com/mod/server-pack-unlocker

(using My Resource Pack, My Choice)-**ingame you should have the pack above the server pack like this:**
![example texture pack priority](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebc2407e94da568698e2a32c5d1631875b7e8a6d.png)

Other mods that allow client resource packs to override server packs should also work.
